baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated divine name and negated deity frame the preposed على الله with jussive فليتوكل.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exclusive worship and entrusted agency converge: believers hand the affair to the only deity, construed not merely as object of devotion but as sufficient preserving agent.

activation_trace.role: The worship-and-worshipped image makes the negation exclude rival ultimate recipients of entrustment.
The handing-over image supplies an actual transfer of the affair rather than a mood of optimism.
The sufficient preserving agent supplies the functional reason this recipient can bear the transferred affair.

changed_reading.before: A generic exhortation to trust God.
changed_reading.after: A transfer of the affair to the only worshipped one as its sufficient preserving custodian.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The commanded form فليتوكل addresses believers as agents who must do something with dependence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reliance branch is bounded by two failure images in the same root: helpless offloading and reciprocal passing of responsibility until the affair is lost. Commanded trust therefore delegates without dereliction.

activation_trace.role: The dependence-and-reliance image supplies the positive posture commanded in the focus.
The helpless person who offloads his affair supplies one internal failure boundary for reliance.
Mutual dependence that loses the affair supplies the social failure boundary: responsibility cannot simply circulate away.

changed_reading.before: Trust means surrendering effort because another will act.
changed_reading.after: Trust means active delegation to the sufficient agent while refusing helplessness and mutually neglected duty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The subject المؤمنون and predicate-command يتوكل join the faith and reliance roots in one clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Believing is read both as settled assent and as heart-security; the command makes reliance the enacted risk posture of that assent, not merely a group label.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security and trust supply the affective state that the named believers seek.
Assent that brings rest to the heart supplies the believers' epistemic commitment.
Reliance turns settled assent into a practical stance toward uncertain outcomes.

changed_reading.before: Believers are simply the audience told to trust.
changed_reading.after: Believers are identified by converting settled assent into a relocated source of security under uncertainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal worship, dominion, and effective capacity explain why the focus's entrusted agent is sufficient: the transfer is made within an already governed order.

activation_trace.role: The sufficient preserving agent is the focus-side role whose adequacy receives contextual support.
Worship through glorification and prayer supplies the universal field in which the focus's exclusive worship operates.
Kingship and sovereignty supply comprehensive control of the domain containing the entrusted affair.
Effective ability to accomplish and possess supplies executable capacity, not title alone.

structural_cues: 64:1 places universal glorification, dominion, and capacity in one predication at the opening of the packet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal worship, sovereignty, and capacity; I infer that these jointly ground the custodian's sufficiency. A live alternative is that 64:1 is doxological framing without a specific agency argument.

changed_reading.before: Entrustment is required solely because the focus commands it.
changed_reading.after: Entrustment is rationalized by a custodian whose worship, rule, and ability span the whole field of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calamity is permitted to land rather than promised away; faith is then linked to gentle guidance of the heart. Trust becomes post-impact reorientation, not an immunity contract.

activation_trace.role: Reliance is the focus posture being revised from preventive expectation to response under impact.
An affliction that strikes a person supplies the adverse event that reliance does not cancel.
The split-root image of exhausting ordeal intensifies the event's lived impact and prevents an abstract reading of calamity.
Permission supplies a bounded authorization relation for the event without itself specifying why it occurs.
Settled assent supplies the human condition paired with heart-guidance after the event.
Gentle direction toward the path supplies the corrective process available within distress.
The heart image locates guidance inside the believer rather than in removal of the external event.
Turning a thing from its face activates reorientation as the heart's possible operation, not as a replacement meaning for the noun.

structural_cues: 64:11's exception construction and faith-to-heart-guidance sequence occur immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impact, permission, faith, guidance, and heart; I infer that reliance names a stance through which the heart can be redirected after impact. A live alternative is that heart-guidance and tawakkul are adjacent benefits without a causal link.

changed_reading.before: Trust should keep adverse events from reaching the believer.
changed_reading.after: Trust keeps the believer delegating through an adverse event while the heart is gently reoriented within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's task is bounded at clear delivery; the focus then assigns reliance to God. Human obligation remains real while control of reception and result is not loaded onto the messenger or believer.

activation_trace.role: Handing over the affair supplies the focus-side transfer of outcome-control.
The agent who sufficiently carries an entrusted affair supplies the destination of what exceeds human office.
Messenger and message supply a defined human office rather than comprehensive control.
Conveying a message supplies the action that fulfills that office.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign supplies the quality and endpoint of delivery.

structural_cues: 64:12 restricts the messenger's burden with إنما and على, then 64:13 reuses على while shifting from delivery-duty to reliance on God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a limited office of clear conveyance and then God-directed reliance; I infer a duty/outcome boundary. A live alternative is that the parallel preposition is rhetorical continuity without a technical allocation of responsibility.

changed_reading.before: Trust is broad dependence with no account of what humans still owe.
changed_reading.after: Trust performs role-allocation: fulfill the bounded act of clear duty, then entrust reception and outcome to the sufficient agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intimate relations can carry real hostility, yet caution is followed by pardon, graceful turning, protective covering, and mercy. Reliance supports alertness without compulsive retaliation or total relational control.

activation_trace.role: Heart-security supplies an inner base from which believers can face relational danger without denying it.
Reliance relocates final protection away from complete control of close relations.
Enmity supplies genuine relational threat rather than imagined unease.
Wakeful precaution supplies the non-naive response to that threat.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault supplies release of retaliatory control.
Graceful turning from fault supplies a relational posture beyond bare non-punishment.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer from the effect supplies restorative containment.
Tender mercy supplies the positive end of the caution-to-release sequence.

structural_cues: 64:14 places caution before three coordinated release verbs and closes by naming forgiveness and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intimate threat, wakeful caution, and escalating release; I infer that God-directed reliance permits both boundaries and mercy by reducing the demand to control every relational outcome. A live alternative is that these are independent household ethics rather than effects of tawakkul.

changed_reading.before: Trust means either feeling safe with close relations or withdrawing from them when threatened.
changed_reading.after: Trust permits a dual stance: remain wakefully bounded toward real threat while releasing punitive control through pardon and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and children, ordinary stores of continuity and security, are recoded as assay material; recompense is located in God's presence. Trust becomes relocation of both security and valuation.

activation_trace.role: Security and confidence supply the need that possessions and descendants can appear to satisfy.
Reliance supplies the alternative placement of that security.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the accumulated asset pole of the test.
Offspring from one's line supply continuity and intimate investment as a second security pole.
Assaying metal or person turns the two assets into media that reveal quality under test.
Nearness and presence locate the counterweight to owned assets with God.
Recompense for work supplies a value not reducible to present asset accumulation.

structural_cues: 64:15 restrictively identifies wealth and children as trial, then contrasts them with recompense عند God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulated assets, descendants, assay, divine presence, and recompense; I infer that these expose where security and value have been delegated. A live alternative is that the verse warns about distraction without redefining tawakkul's object.

changed_reading.before: Trust is an inward feeling compatible with treating assets and descendants as the real security reserve.
changed_reading.after: Trust is exposed by the assay: security and ultimate value move from accumulated continuity to what is present with God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet joins self-protection, spending, inner appetite, grasping restraint, and durable success. Reliance becomes materially observable when resources leave the hand; the danger shifts from depletion to the self's hoarding impulse.

activation_trace.role: Reliance supplies the security posture tested by release of resources.
Placing the self in protection supplies the verse's protective frame and redirects it toward protection from inner grasping.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the concrete release through which reliance becomes visible.
What lies within the self as reason and alarm locates the contested valuation internally.
Withholding joined to greed supplies the rival strategy that seeks safety by retention.
Winning with continuance supplies an outcome that reverses the hoarder's fear that release means loss.

structural_cues: 64:16 chains hearing, obedience, and spending, then places the protected danger inside the self before naming the successful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, outflow, inner grasping, and enduring success; I infer that spending is a behavioral assay of reliance because it contests hoarding as self-protection. A live alternative is that expenditure is simply one adjacent command among several.

changed_reading.before: Trust can remain internal while safety is maintained by holding resources tightly.
changed_reading.after: Trust becomes resource release: the self needs protection from hoarding, and durable success can lie on the far side of outflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paradox of lending to the only deity converts reliance into counterparty risk willingly taken: capital or work is cut loose for returned recompense, increase, appreciative reception of little, and patient timing.

activation_trace.role: Handing an affair to another supplies the focus-side structure of exposure to a counterparty.
Cutting away wealth or work so its recompense returns supplies the loan's transfer-and-return mechanism.
Cutting capital for trade supplies the sharper image of putting a reserve at risk rather than merely giving surplus.
The sole worshipped one appears as the named recipient, intensifying the paradox of treating divine-directed release as a loan.
Increase by another like amount supplies return that exceeds the released unit.
Sufficiency with little and manifestation of its effect supplies appreciative reception that makes a small release consequential.
Forbearance and self-command supply patient timing rather than immediate settlement.

structural_cues: 64:17 follows the spending command with a conditional loan, multiplication, forgiveness, gratitude, and forbearance sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cut capital, promised return, multiplication, appreciative sufficiency, and patience; I infer a counterparty-risk analogy for tawakkul. A live alternative is that loan language concerns charity's reward without modeling reliance itself.

changed_reading.before: Trust is inward dependence with no necessary exposure of what one controls.
changed_reading.after: Trust can be enacted as releasing controlled capital or work to a divine counterparty and accepting deferred, transformed return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pair spans what is hidden and what is present to observation, while power and exact wisdom qualify the recipient of delegation. Trust includes unknown variables without denying witnessed evidence.

activation_trace.role: Entrusting the affair supplies the transfer whose informational scope is being enlarged.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the unobservable portion of the entrusted affair.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the observable portion that trust need not suppress.
Prevailing power supplies ability to govern across both informational domains.
Accurate wisdom supplies discriminating judgment rather than undirected force.
Delegation and arbitration form a branch-level echo of the focus's entrustment, linking wise rule to assigned decision authority.

structural_cues: 64:18 closes the packet with paired unseen and witnessed domains followed by paired power and wisdom titles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, witnessed presence, prevailing power, wisdom, and a delegation branch; I infer that tawakkul covers unknown variables while retaining observed facts. A live alternative is that the close is general doxology and the delegation echo in حكم is only associative.

changed_reading.before: Trust is blind acceptance where evidence and unknowns are treated alike.
changed_reading.after: Trust delegates the whole field to powerful, discerning rule while distinguishing witnessed evidence from variables hidden to the believer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because neither an oath construction nor an explicit آمين appears; it remains anchored in the repeated divine name, المؤمنون, and commanded entrustment. Render only as a performative call-and-response resonance, not as a claim about the clause's grammatical category.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The divine name occurs three times around negation and a jussive command addressed through the believer noun.

activation_trace.role: The divine name used in oath and call supplies a performative resonance to its repetition in the focus.
The آمين response requesting realization supplies a distant call-and-response echo within the believer root.
Actual entrustment supplies the pledged action that keeps the resonance anchored in the focus command.

changed_reading.before: The focus is only a doctrinal declaration followed by advice.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also resonate as a compressed invocation and enacted pledge: name the sole deity, then answer by entrusting the affair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it crosses from cosmic glorification into locomotion and uses a negative animal image from the trust root; it remains anchored in يتوكل and the universal subject of 64:1. Render as a material analogy distinguishing trust from inertia, never as the lexical translation of either word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The command to يتوكل can be tested against the same root's image of a mount that lags by depending on its rider.

activation_trace.role: The lagging dependent mount supplies the inert failure image against which commanded trust can be read.
Running or swimming supplies a field of sustained motion for the universal glorification at the packet's opening.

changed_reading.before: Reliance is safest when the believer stops moving and waits.
changed_reading.after: Reliance can be imagined as ceasing to lag and moving within an already God-governed current.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because recurrence comes from the non-dominant ع و د mapping of context root ع د و; it remains anchored in the focus's reliance and heart-security plus 64:14's explicit caution. Render as a recurrence cue for practice, not as the lexical meaning of عدو.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The commanded reliance and believer-security can be renewed rather than treated as a one-time achievement.

activation_trace.role: Reliance supplies the focus practice that may need renewal under repeated relational pressure.
Heart-security supplies the state repeatedly contested and restored.
Return after departure and repetition after a beginning activate recurrence within the packet's split-root inventory.
Wakeful precaution keeps the recurrence model tied to the explicit response to relational danger.

changed_reading.before: One decisive act of trust should permanently settle relational fear.
changed_reading.after: Trust may be a repeatedly renewed return to delegated security as intimate threat and caution recur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it links the Day of mutual loss to later credit language across the focus; it remains anchored in توكل as handing an affair to another and in explicit packet branches for transactional loss and repayable release. Render as a valuation mechanism, not a claim that tawakkul itself means commerce.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Entrustment necessarily selects a counterparty, allowing the focus command to interact with the packet's gain-loss and loan images.

activation_trace.role: Handing an affair to another supplies the counterparty relation anchored directly in the focus.
Being underpaid or diminished in a transaction supplies the risk of choosing a false valuation.
Missing something through heedlessness supplies the temporal discovery of misvaluation.
Cutting away wealth or work for returned recompense supplies an alternative exchange relation.
Increase by another like amount supplies the packet's reversal of apparent present loss.

changed_reading.before: Trust concerns emotional confidence independently of valuation and exchange.
changed_reading.after: Trust can function as counterparty selection that resists present mispricing and accepts an exchange whose value becomes legible later.

strongest_changes: Trust shifts from promised immunity to a guided-heart response after permitted calamity.
The parallel burdens of clear delivery and God-directed reliance allocate human duty while entrusting reception and outcome.
Family threat, asset-assay, spending, and loan language turn trust into vigilant mercy and material release rather than passive feeling.
The unseen-and-witnessed close extends delegation across known evidence and hidden variables.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory itself resisted passivity: sufficient custody coexists with warnings against helpless or mutually neglectful reliance. Context then activated calamity, household danger, assay, anti-hoarding, credit, locomotion, recurrence, and valuation models without forcing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The invocation, آمين, and locomotion resonances are branch-distant and must remain exploratory.
The returning-threat activation depends on the non-dominant ع و د mapping of ع د و; it marks recurrence, not the lexical meaning of عدو.
Packet sequence supports but does not prove that tawakkul causally generates every later ethical action.
